text:
morgan: Heads-up — noticed a spike in SM% and a jump in KV cache evictions on prod-v2 around 11:12 UTC after the canary rollout. Where are the exact Grafana panels and traces so I can slice this quickly? pinging @devon @sam :eyes:

devon: Panels: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd123/gpu-overview?orgId=1 — use panelId=42 (SM% heatmap) and panelId=87 (KV cache evictions). Traces in Tempo: https://tempo.redwood.com/search — filter service=runtime, env=prod, and tag pool=prod-v2. :point_up:

sam: quick CLI helpers: `rb query --pool prod-v2 --metric sm_utilization --since 30m` and `rb query --metric kvcache_evictions --since 1h --pool prod-v2`. Also added a short pointer on the runtime ops doc: /dashboards/gpu/ (internal).

morgan: thanks — do we have a runbook for the KV eviction alert? It was noisy this morning, want to tune rather than spam oncall.

devon: runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/kvcache-runbook — recommendation is to increase the alert evaluation window to 5m and raise threshold from 20% to 30% for canary-tagged pools. I'll open a PR to update the Grafana alert rule. :thumbsup:

lee: fyi I saw the canary config bumped batch_size -> 8 yesterday (was 4). Could be the root cause (more concurrent tokens -> higher SM% and pressure on KV). @devon can you check the canary deployment config?

devon: confirmed the canary change. I rolled the canary back to batch_size=4 on the test job for now and will run a quick perf sweep: `/scripts/perf/run_batch_sweep --pool prod-v2 --batches 4,8 --duration 10m`. Will paste results.

morgan: also need the KV cache hitrate timeseries panel id — want to correlate misses with evictions.

sam: panelId=91 is `kvcache_hitrate`. When querying traces, look for span `runtime.generate` and tag `kvcache.miss=true` — that surfaces the requests that observed misses. Use the trace timeline to see if misses align with GC/eviction events.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-314 (assigned to devon). Auto-silenced for 15m.

devon: pulling logs now. If you want raw logs: `rb logs --since 1h --service runtime --pool prod-v2` or check s3 path `s3://redwood-logs/prod-v2/`. I'll post the top evicted keys and a short sample trace in a follow-up.

lee: +1 to adjusting the alert and adding a per-pool KV eviction rate panel to the SLA dashboard so this is easier to spot next time.

morgan: perfect — once devon posts perf numbers we can decide whether to keep batch_size=4 for canary or add a gradual ramp. thanks team :rocket:
